results.title: Eddie Hearn opens up on an unusual episode with Tyson Fury as Gypsy King invited him for tea after brutally trolling him on Instagram
results.description: Tyson Fury and Eddie Hearn have experienced a complex relationship characterized by public hostility and private friendliness. Hearn recalled a meeting where he confronted Fury after an Instagram rant in Las Vegas. They shared a pleasant conversation about boxing during their tea meeting at Fury's hotel room. Their private interactions often reveal a different side to their rivalry.
